description: Reschedule into a slot another patient already holds.
turns: Mera 8 tareekh ka appointment shift karna hai, shaam 4 baje kar dijiye.

expected.notes: 16:00 on 2026-10-08 with Dr. Rao belongs to another patient. A naive agent only checks the doctor's working window and double-books, or silently moves the caller to a time they never asked for. The name alone also matches three Sharmas; only the phone resolves it.
